text:
customer-jon: We're seeing intermittent JSON parse errors in structured mode when streaming SSE from /v1/chat. Example: when the model emits a Unicode escape that's split across chunks (e.g. '\uD83D' in one SSE event, 'uDE0A' in the next), our client (EventSource) treats each event as a full JSON doc and throws 'Invalid \u escape' during parse. This is reproducible for us.

customer-jon: Repro request (curl):
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-13b","mode":"structured","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Emoji test: \\uD83D\\uDE0A"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

customer-jon: Partial response we see (SSE events):
```
event: message
data: {"id":"tok1","delta":"Emoji test: \\uD83D"

event: message
data: {"id":"tok2","delta":"\\uDE0A"}
```

customer-jon: Parser errors: 'Unexpected token u in JSON at position 34' when parsing first event.

support-bot: Thanks — raised INC-4523 and assigned to support. Can you share request-id and full response headers? Also is this browser EventSource or a custom SSE client?

mike: @customer-jon can you paste the request-id from the response headers (x-request-id) and the exact client lib/version?

customer-jon: x-request-id=req_abc123; using browser EventSource on Chrome 120. If we buffer events until we see a closing brace the parse succeeds.

claire (eng-esc): I can reproduce with EventSource. Root cause: our stream framing currently can split a JSON string containing a backslash-u escape across SSE boundaries; many browser SSE parsers hand each event as a standalone chunk. If client parses each event individually you'll hit a broken \u escape.

claire (eng-esc): Short-term mitigations: 1) buffer SSE events until you detect a complete JSON object (closing '}'), 2) disable streaming (stream:false) for structured_mode, 3) use the non-SSE streaming endpoint that guarantees chunk boundaries (we'll find one).

claire (eng-esc): We're patching the emitter to prefer not splitting inside escape sequences for structured mode. Internal PR + patch scheduled in the next deploy (ETA ~4h). Ticket: ENG-2029.

mike: Adding billing note — customer saw ~120 failed parse attempts; flagged for credits review. CC @finance

support-bot: Escalation posted to oncall eng, added labels: structured-mode, sse, unicode-escape, customer-impact.

customer-jon: Thanks — we'll buffer on our side for now. Please keep me posted, happy to test the patch. :thumbsup:
